claim_boundary: Local single-node failure evidence only; no production SLA, HA, multi-GPU, or customer-traffic claim.
corrective_action: Prevent the open-loop scheduler from replaying missed releases as a catch-up burst.
Record target and actual offered rate, release lag, skipped releases, and delivery ratio; fail closed when the load generator does not deliver the frozen profile.
Run a three-repetition non-acceptance pacing pilot before restarting the complete acceptance matrix.
next_action: Implement and test no-catch-up open-loop pacing, then pass a three-repetition external pacing pilot before any new acceptance run.
root_cause: The selected point failed hard safety during its first 70-percent open-loop repetition. Code audit then found that the open-loop scheduler retained an elapsed next-release timestamp and emitted missed arrivals back-to-back after event-loop delay. Because the evidence did not record release lag, skipped releases, or actual offered-rate delivery, this attempt cannot distinguish a runtime saturation failure from catch-up burst amplification and is invalid for acceptance.
